explanation: This route is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because HTTP POST form input command is passed directly to os.system(command), enabling remote attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands. The repair checks re.match(COMMAND_REGEX, command) before calling subprocess.call(command, shell=True), which cannot be verified because COMMAND_REGEX is undefined, re.match only anchors at the start of the string, and shell=True remains.
